item_name: Rothco US Air Force Flash Patch
item_short_desc: Rothco's US Air Force Flash Patch is the official beret flash for the United States Air Force Security Forces. Measuring 2 1/4" x 2 1/2" and crafted from 100% polyester to meet MIL-DTL-14652 specifications, this durable patch is perfect for military personnel.
